title: Machine learning on routine blood tests predicts SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR result
summary: A gradient boosted decision tree combined age, sex, race and 27 routine laboratory tests to predict SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR status, trained on 3,356 tested patients (1,402 positive). It reached an AUC of 0.854 (95% CI 0.829-0.878) and an AUC of 0.838 in an independent dataset from a separate hospital. The model also predicted RT-PCR positivity in 66% of individuals whose result changed from negative to positive within two days. Retrospective; this is the 2020-06-19 preprint.
